title: Anna's Shopping Trip
text:
Anna goes to the supermarket on Saturday. She has a shopping list in her hand. The list has bread, milk, eggs and apples.

She does not buy oranges because she already has some at home. At the checkout, she pays with a card. Then she goes home and eats an apple.

questions.text: What does Anna have in her hand?

options: She already has some at home

questions.text: What kind of person is Anna most likely?

vocabulary.definition: a written set of things you need to buy or do
a large shop that sells food and other goods
the place in a shop where you pay for your things
round orange fruits with thick skin

paragraph_translations: Anna cumartesi günü süpermarkete gider. Elinde bir alışveriş listesi vardır. Listede ekmek, süt, yumurta ve elma vardır.
Anna portakal almaz, çünkü evde zaten biraz vardır. Kasada kartla öder. Sonra eve gider ve bir elma yer.
